CREATE PROC [DW].[SP_DW_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DEP] AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_CustomerAccountSK AS (
    SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CustomerAccountSK),0) RN FROM dw.DimCustomerAccount  
)
--FOR DEP FILTER
,CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipation WHERE SourceSystemCode IN ('DEP') AND (PeriodEndDate = '1900-01-01T00:00:00.0000000' OR PeriodEndDate = '2099-12-31T00:00:00.0000000')  
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT AS (
SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM TEMP_CustomerAccountSK)  AS CustomerAccountSK
,* FROM (


--FOR DEP FILTER
SELECT DISTINCT 
DDC.CustomerSK AS CustomerSK
,BC.CustomerId AS CustomerID	
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,BCAP.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeSK AS AccountHolderTypeSK
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBR.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDAHT.ShareIndicator AS ShareIndicator
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,GETDATE() AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-01-01' AS ValidEndDate
,DDA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,GETDATE() AS InsertDttm
FROM 
CustomerAccountParticipation_DEP  BCAP
JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = CAFP.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId AND CAFP.PeriodEndDate IS NULL
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,CAFP.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.Customer BC ON BCAP.CoreCustomerId = BC.CoreCustomerId
LEFT JOIN DW.DimCustomer DDC ON BC.CustomerId = DDC.CustomerID AND DDC.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountParticipationAuthorizedSignatory BCAPAS ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCAPAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAPAS.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAP.SerialNumber = BCAPAS.SerialNumber
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccount DDA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCAP.FinancialInstitutionId = DDB.BankID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimAccountHolderType DDAHT  ON BCAPAS.RecordTypeId = DDAHT.AccountHolderTypeID AND DDB.BankSK = DDAHT.BankSK AND BCAP.SourceSystemCode = DDAHT.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccount BCA ON BCAP.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId 
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBR ON BCA.BranchID = DDBR.BranchID AND DDBR.CurrentIndicator = 1
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%')
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')


    ) A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT;

WITH
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator             
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
    CustomerSK
    ,CustomerID	
    ,AccountSK
    ,AccountID
    ,AccountHolderTypeSK
    ,BankSK
    ,BranchSK
    ,ShareIndicator  
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,CustomerID,BankSK 
    FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
)
,
TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA
AS
(
    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerID,TGT.CustomerID) AS CustomerID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,CASE
        WHEN TGT.CustomerID IS NULL AND TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_SRC SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerID = TGT.CustomerID
AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR (TGT.CUSTOMERID IS NULL AND TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA FROM TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA;

--UPDATE
UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = GETDATE()
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DimCustomerAccount TGT
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT SRC ON SRC.CustomerId = TGT.CustomerId AND SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 and SourceSystemCode = 'DEP';




INSERT INTO DW.DimCustomerAccount (
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,CustomerID
,AccountSK
,AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,ShareIndicator
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)
SELECT 
CustomerAccountSK
,CustomerSK
,SRC.CustomerID
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountHolderTypeSK
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,Convert(varchar,ShareIndicator)
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT SRC
JOIN #TEMP_DIMCUSTOMERACCOUNT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerId = SRC.CustomerId  AND DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT');

END
GO
